text:
Priya (AE): quick kickoff — Acme wants a 6-week POC to validate retrieval + generation for customer support automation. goals: 1) reduce average handle time for support replies, 2) meet privacy reqs, 3) show cost delta vs current infra. proposed timeline attached below.

Alex (SE): on it. can we lock success criteria now? need concrete evals and latency SLO.

Marta (PM): success criteria suggestion: - Eval pass rate >= 85% on labeled test prompts (N=500) - Median gen latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms - End-to-end ticket deflection >= 15% within 6 weeks - No PII exfil incidents in security QA.

Priya (AE): yes that looks good. also customer will need a TCO estimate vs their existing hosted provider — can we get rough cost numbers by week2?

Alex (SE): week2 we can run representative workload on Dedicated profile + quantized model. need sample prompt set and traffic distribution from them. ask SE to provide: 1) 200 sample tickets, 2) expected qps (peak/avg), 3) any flag for regulated content.

Luis (Eng): I can build an eval harness (quick pytest + sample harness). will push a repo template. planning to output: precision/recall, exact-match on canned answers, latency histograms, token counts.

Kevin (SRE): for infra, we need SE availability for two canary deploys and an oncall window for week4 rollout. who is primary SE?

Alex (SE): I can be primary for canaries. availability: Mon/Wed mornings PST for the next 4 weeks. prefer to schedule canary1 end of week3, canary2 mid-week4.

Priya (AE): noted. Marta, can you align customer dates? they asked to finish acceptance by week6 end.

Marta (PM): I'll confirm. also adding a deliverables checklist: - Week1: prompt set + security Q (completed by customer) - Week2: TCO draft + eval harness skeleton - Week3: first model run + performance baseline - Week4: canary deploy + monitoring dashboard - Week5: iterate prompts/quantization - Week6: acceptance test + handover playbook.

Priya (AE): Security question: customer asked about data handling and key management. sec-bot, do we have a one-pager for Redwood Private KMS options?

sec-bot: Uploaded doc: https://redwood.docs/sec/kms-options. Short: we support customer-managed KMS (HSM) for Private, RBAC access logs, and audit retention options. Export controls need legal review if data crosses regions.

Alex (SE): operational notes: 1) we should enable prefix KV caching for repeated sessions, 2) use batched generation for off-peak TCO numbers, 3) fallback policy: if p95 latency >500ms for 10m, route to smaller quantized model automatically. will add this to runbook.

Luis (Eng): request from my side: can the customer grant a read-only S3 for 200 tickets? and a small synthetic dataset for stress tests.

Priya (AE): I'll request access this afternoon. also pricing: customer asked about Dedicated monthly commit vs pay-as-you-go during POC. finance wants concrete ask by Friday. Alex/Luis, can you give a conservative and aggressive cost estimate?

Alex (SE): conservative = Dedicated small pool with burst (estimate in spreadsheet), aggressive = hosted API with caching. I'll drop numbers in the shared sheet by Thursday COB.

Marta (PM): blockers: legal has a redline on the DPA for data residency. flagged to legal — working with customer to see if Private deployment is needed.

Kevin (SRE): FYI — if Private is required, schedule slips by ~2 weeks for infra provisioning. calling that out now so sales can set expectations.

Priya (AE): perfect. action items: 1) Priya: get sample tickets + S3 access (today) 2) Alex/Luis: cost estimates + eval harness skeleton (Thu) 3) Marta: confirm customer calendar + legal status (EOD Fri) 4) Kevin: tentative oncall windows for canaries (send calendar invite). I'll follow up with the customer thread after we have costs. :thumbsup:

Alex (SE): ack. I'll start a draft runbook and link it here when ready.

Luis (Eng): pushing repo now — will include a README with acceptance command and example output.

Marta (PM): thanks all. loop back during tomorrow's presales sync if anything changes.

Priya (AE): closing loop — will DM legal and customer for the ticket samples.

(edited)
